static_traits.name: Zhang Yu
static_traits.social_status: Has one close and supportive friend, but has not yet discussed related feelings with them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not received counseling for this issue before
static_traits.language_features: Attitude leaning negative but high cooperation; clear expression, able to self-Reflect; cautious and hesitant when involving self-disclosure; able to set small goals and willing to try gradual change

basic_info.main_problem: Worrying about being seen by others as 'strange/childish' due to loving anime and attending comic conventions multiple times; feeling shame and Anxiety about being judged in Social situations, especially when talking about interests; thus avoiding sharing, affecting confidence and building deep relationships.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of being evaluated began to affect my confidence and social interaction.' I also hope to gradually reduce shame, enhance confidence, and try first to share content about my interests with supportive friends.
growth_experiences: Since adolescence, long feeling judged and ashamed due to society's stereotypes and misunderstandings about anime fans; these feelings continued into adulthood, leading to avoiding discussing interests in Social situations and difficulty forming deep connections. Has not received relevant counseling before, with no obvious physical problems.

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others

special_situations.event: When talking about one's interests or hobbies in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I talk publicly about anime and conventions, I will be labeled 'childish/weird', and thus judged and rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to avoid talking about interests in social settings; trying to 'cast the thoughts aside and focus on the positive side of the hobby' to reduce discomfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am strange, childish

special_situations.event: When others learn about or ask about my experience attending multiple comic conventions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others know I often attend comic conventions, they will conclude I am not mature enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hiding relevant information, downplaying or not proactively mentioning attending comic conventions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Adults should not like anime; I should not be like this

special_situations.event: When with supportive friends but considering whether to share feelings about interests and shame
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even close friends may look down on me based on social stereotypes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps silent, avoids deep self-disclosure to prevent being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He may not understand and will think I am childish

special_situations.event: When recalling the conflict between social stereotypes and one's own positive experiences (creativity and sense of community)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Society generally looks down on anime fans, so my positive experience 'does not count'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive evidence, continuously viewing myself with negative labels
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Even though I love it and gain community from it, others will still think I am a weirdo

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted, able to Freedom and naturally express interest in anime, and build deeper interpersonal connections
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, humiliated, and rejected, being seen as childish or strange
defense_goal: Self-protecting by keeping Silence and avoiding
Keeps a safe distance from others to reduce the risk of being judged
Uses socially stereotyped explanations to reduce emotional exposure and vulnerability

object_relations.self_representation: A shy outsider, someone easily labeled
A hobbyist needing to be understood and accepted
object_relations.object_representation: Intimate others who may understand but may also judge
object_relations.linking_affect: Conflict, hesitation, hope, and worry coexist

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited in the session or in real life to talk about / share one's anime interests
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing the counselor or others as possibly judging me with the label 'childish/strange' (transference tinged with Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone, affirming and normalizing; avoiding judgmental language; inviting description of specific scenarios and emotions with open-ended Questioning; gradually Guiding them to identify and name feelings like Shame, fear.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking 'what will others think of me' or discussing social stereotypes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing the outside world as a whole as potential negaters, Anticipating that others will uniformly evaluate me negatively
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Supportive and Empathy tone; Guiding them to focus on body and present experience, helping express repressed emotions at a safe magnitude; using specification and evidence examination, distinguishing facts from assumptions.

manifestations: Finding it hard to Freedom express interests in Social situations, worrying about being labeled 'childish/strange'
Feeling self-congruence and Freedom brought by creativity and community in the comic-convention context
Avoiding sharing interests makes deep connections hard to build
Has supportive friends but hesitates whether to express real feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: Treats society's stereotypes of anime fans as the standard for evaluating herself
Internalizes the label 'anime = childish / weird', weakening self-acceptance

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 'They will think I am childish/strange', 'others will look down on me'
Assuming others' negative attitudes without verification yet

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Is overly cautious before sharing interests, worried about making mistakes or being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to perform a certain behavior toward other people or things, and instead acts on themselves, recovering the energy rather than expressing it outward.
manifestations: Has the urge to express interests and feelings but chooses to stay silent
Avoiding discussing true feelings with friends, instead self-Repressing and self-labeling

exception_events.target_problem: When talking about interests in AverageSocial situations, Zhang Yu usually worries about being judged and chooses to avoid, leading to difficulty building deep relationships.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the setting of attending a comic convention, he experienced a positive atmosphere of creativity and community, felt more at ease and accepted, and worried less about being evaluated than usual.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different situation (fellow enthusiasts gathering, stereotypes weakened); different relationship (people sharing the interest present, gaining acceptance and belonging).

positive_force: Love of the interest and the community brings self-consistency and a sense of belonging
Has a supportive friend who can serve as a safe person to share with
Stable occupational functioning, Work performance not yet affected
negative_force: Overly caring about others' evaluations and seeking external validation
Mind reading and predicting-the-future tendencies intensifying insecurity
Self-labeling and avoiding self-disclosure leading to Interpersonal alienation
Shame and Decreased self-confidence affecting daily self-care

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding discussing personal interests (anime and comic conventions) in social situations, and engaging in Self-denial/labeling
antecedent: When asked about interests or actively discussing hobbies
When thinking of society's stereotypes about anime lovers
Before sharing with supportive friends, hesitation and shame arise
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged as 'childish/strange', Introjecting social stereotypes and engaging in mind reading and negative prediction, highly dependent on external recognition to judge self-worth.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the potential risk of being judged and rejected, reducing the uncomfortable experience of shame and Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building deep relationships, Damaged self-confidence, daily self-care and quality of life affected.
